channel.title: Andalusia Star News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Andalusia Star News (andalusiastarnews.com)

item.title: Local woman changes Alabama lives
item.description: Andalusia native Valerie Cunningham-Trainer marks 10 years leading Make-A-Wish Alabama’s Trailblaze Challenge, a $7M effort, as she seeks hometown support to fund two more wishes.

item.title: Christian Service Center hosts Poster Contest
item.description: Christian Service Center's January poster contest for Sanctity of Human Life Month invited local Christians to celebrate the sanctity of life, with gift certificates for winners.

item.title: First Responder Spotlight: Chance
item.description: Opp native Kevin Chance traces his journey from junior rescue squad member to police chief and explains why his department feels like family as they work to fill one last opening.

item.title: OHS Cheer notches another state, national championship
item.description: Opp High School cheerleaders capped a “rebuilding” year by sweeping 2026 state titles and earning their 11th UCA national crown, the seniors’ fourth championship with coach Lorrie Harrison.

item.title: Andalusia Area Chamber of Commerce hosts 2026 Banquet
item.description: The Andalusia Area Chamber of Commerce celebrated local businesses and citizens at its Feb. 5, 2026 banquet, honoring award winners and hearing an inspiring address by guest speaker Tommy Jackson.

item.title: BERRY IS MISS MEMOLUSIA
item.description: Andalusia High School crowned Jaidyn Berry Miss Memolusia 2026 at the 55th annual pageant Feb. 7, with Junior Miss honors going to Andalusia Junior High’s Jadah Fields.

item.title: Saturday | February 14, 2026 E-edition
item.description: Explore the full digital version of our February 14, 2026 issue and stay updated with the latest news and features.

item.title: Jeanette Fore Harrison Obituary
item.description: Jeanette Fore Harrison, 88, of Andalusia, AL, died Feb. 12, 2026; services Feb. 15 at Foreman Funeral Home with burial at Stone Lake Memorial Gardens.

item.title: Ray Jordan Obituary
item.description: Gerald Ray Jordan, 67, of Andalusia, died Feb. 9, 2026; funeral Feb. 12 at Foreman Funeral Home Chapel, with burial in Andalusia Memorial Cemetery.

item.title: Jail Report from February 10 to February 11
item.description: Covington County Jail report lists Feb. 10–11 bookings, with charges ranging from failure to appear and probation violations to drug offenses, rape and sodomy.
